title: UneceSpecifiedParameter
description: A specified feature that is fixed for the case in question but may be different in other cases.

description.description: A textual description for this specified parameter.

identifier.description: The identifier of this specified parameter.

name.description: The name, expressed as text, for this specified parameter.

parameterType.description: A type, expressed as text, for this specified parameter.

statusCode.description: The code specifying the status of this specified parameter.

statusValueMeasure.description: A measure of a value of the status for this specified parameter.

typeCode.description: The code specifying the type of parameter.

value.description: The value, expressed as text, for this specified parameter.

valueAllowedIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not the value for this specified parameter is allowed.

valueMeasure.description: A measure of a value for this specified parameter.

valueTolerance.description: A tolerance specified for the value of this parameter.
